A [[Youngling/Legends|young]] '''Wookiee''' was kept in a [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] camp run by a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pekt's clan|clan]].<ref name="GB" /> At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the valiant [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] broke out of his bonds and grabbed the young Trandoshan [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pekt]] in his massive [[Limb/Legends|paws]]. Pekt stared coldly at his attacker while his arms were torn off by the Wookiee, who was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] for his efforts. The Trandoshan then returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] to recuperate, and his arms had regenerated within a [[Standard month/Legends|month]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee was mentioned in Pekt's DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
